paper_title: Dark Matter Search with a Resonantly-Coupled Hybrid Spin System
coupling_convention: g_ann (axion-neutron coupling) in GeV^-1, plotted as on y-axis
notes: Broadband K-Rb-21Ne hybrid spin comagnetometer (ChangE collaboration) searching axion-nucleon couplings over Compton frequencies [0.01,1000] Hz. Paper reports BOTH axion-neutron (gann) and axion-proton (gapp) limits at 95% C.L.; chose AxionNeutron per hint and as the flagship result (gann <= 3e-10 GeV^-1 in [0.02,4] Hz via SC regime; ~3e-9 GeV^-1 in [3,30] Hz via HSR; scaling ~f^2 for [30,1000] Hz). Full tabulated data are in an external reference [38], not in the paper text, so points are APPROXIMATE reconstructions from stated text values. Couplings given in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling), NOT the dimensionless g_an convention - a factor of ~2*m_n conversion would be needed for the canonical dimensionless form. Frequencies converted to mass via m=4.136e-15*f.
